name: 换身之后，将军画风不对了
original_name: 换身之后，将军画风不对了
overview: Shen Zhao, oppressed as the mistress of a general’s household, unexpectedly swaps bodies with General Chu Muyi. Experiencing each other’s lives, they develop a deep bond while Shen Zhao uses the general’s authority to uncover the truth behind her father’s wrongful exile.
